title: Vagus Nerve Stimulation (VNS)
description: CMS National Coverage Determination for Vagus Nerve Stimulation (NCD 160.18) for medically refractory partial onset seizures.

change_log.author: CMS MCD Coverage API
change_log.summary: Transcribed from CMS NCD 160.18 via official Coverage API.

criteria.name: Medically Refractory Partial Onset Seizures
criteria.description: Diagnosis of medically refractory partial onset seizures for whom resective epilepsy surgery is not recommended or has failed.
criteria.clinical_intent: Document drug-resistant partial seizures unsuitable for resective surgery
criteria.required_temporal_window: Clinical progress note or diagnostic report
criteria.source_text_excerpt: medically refractory partial onset seizures for whom surgery is not recommended or for whom surgery has failed.<&sol

criteria.name: Failure of Optimal Antiepileptic Drug Regimens
criteria.description: Documented failure of at least two appropriately chosen and tolerated antiepileptic drug (AED) trials at therapeutic dosages.
criteria.clinical_intent: Demonstrate failure of conservative medical pharmacotherapy
criteria.required_temporal_window: Clinical progress note or diagnostic report
criteria.source_text_excerpt: VNS is reasonable and necessary for patients with medically refractory partial onset seizures for whom surgery

criteria.name: FDA-Approved Implantable VNS Device
criteria.description: Use of an FDA-approved vagus nerve stimulator system with surgical evaluation confirming candidate anatomy and clearance.
criteria.clinical_intent: Mandate FDA-approved vagal nerve stimulation system
criteria.required_temporal_window: Clinical progress note or diagnostic report
criteria.source_text_excerpt: VNS is reasonable and necessary for patients with medically refractory partial onset seizures for whom surgery
